The oldest member of the squad at the age of 38,  this  right-arm
medium  pace  bowler  has played first-class cricket in Pakistan.
While he has slowed down in pace, he is still capable of  bowling
tight    spells   and  usually  opens  the bowling  with  Johanne
Samarasekera.
